verdict.rationale: Brex's own Payments API documentation states it can manage vendors and send ACH and domestic wires, which directly matches the story. Bill pay and automated invoice payments are also documented first-party, and Pipedream integration docs reference sending vendor payments. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the ACH/wire workflow (limits, timing, approvals) and of a non-API UI path for finance leads, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send domestic ACH and wire payments to vendors
